claims.statement: Rule and Fact input planes must remain distinct from the deterministic Guide control plane and from MethodRef knowledge inputs; effective Direction must resolve to a declared Rule.
claims.falsified_by: a conforming runtime treats Guide as advisory source material, injects Direction without a declared Rule, or implicitly promotes a Fact or MethodRef to an authorizing Rule

claims.statement: Position is role-bound on one canonical world: role definition is a Rule, actor–role Assignment is an admitted authority- and liveness-bearing Fact, and consuming that Assignment requires live EvidentialWarranty and AuthorityWarranty.
claims.falsified_by: a runtime treats a role label as an assignment, treats timeline presence as an admitted Fact, or consumes the assignment without both required live Warranties

claims.statement: One Candidate has one semantic Entrance even when it has several interface projections.
claims.falsified_by: a certificate combines independent undeclared entrance identities

claims.statement: A complete WorldRef binds project/run/generation, repository/base, environment, contiguous RAW prefix, admission Rule/receipt/root, projector, and derived state; a WorldSpan extends only that RAW prefix under the same generation rules.
claims.falsified_by: a valid certificate accepts an incomplete or branch-relative WorldRef, treats timeline presence as an admitted Fact, or crosses a base, admission-Rule, projector, project, run, or generation boundary

claims.statement: Traversal receipt and path certificate remain orthogonal to the exactly two Warranty kinds, EvidentialWarranty and AuthorityWarranty; liveness is a Warranty state dimension, not a third kind.
claims.falsified_by: one surface is automatically minted solely from another

claims.statement: Authority logs are optional format-free exogenous reminders whose presence never gates participation, validation, baseline comparison, or Warranty issuance; absence means unknown/not_assessed rather than approved.
claims.falsified_by: core Candidate or ordinary comparison validation requires an authority log, derives AuthorityWarranty from log presence, or treats absence as approval

claims.statement: Repair re-enters U to scope-indexed C only through a new frozen Candidate, fresh traversal, PathCertificate, and live EvidentialWarranty without rewriting history; its actor–role Assignment also needs live AuthorityWarranty before consumption.
claims.falsified_by: constructing a Candidate is treated as C or evidence from two revisions is spliced into one certificate or warranty

claims.statement: An open Candidate is a mutable version-identifiable proposal; only a frozen semantic closure is immutable and certifiable.
claims.falsified_by: an open proposal is certified or frozen semantic bytes change without a new revision

claims.statement: Physical mechanisms may combine P, D, and E responsibilities while their propositions and authority/warranty evidence remain separately checkable.
claims.falsified_by: a composite component makes one proof receipt automatically satisfy a distinct proposition

claims.statement: P, D, and E are conditioned on role/world/datum/history and may only be factorized as a conditional chain; run or scenario remains the primary clustered experimental unit.
claims.falsified_by: marginal rates are multiplied or decision events and roles are treated as independent experimental units

claims.statement: Paper-grounded diagnosis classifies the violated invariant as P, D, or E, records action-execution failure separately as X, and remains advisory rather than minting a warranty or estimator.
claims.falsified_by: a diagnosis classifies by file, module, actor, or message source instead of the violated invariant, or its receipt is treated as a warranty, authorization, estimator, or empirical result
